dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the wide mid-section toward a sharp posterior termination at the peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to slate-grey median pixel intensity with high-value specular highlights concentrated on the anterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the lighter central dorsal region and the darker shaded lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, high-contrast linear marks (scratches) are visible, primarily oriented longitudinally on the right and upper-left dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A sharp, shadow-casting longitudinal ridge is visible along the posterior dorsal midline, indicating a distinct topological elevation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks or scars distributed across the dorsal epidermal plane.
